## Determining sparsity level with the highest enrichment for DE genes

Summarize nTargets per TF across cell types

```{r}
cutoffs <- c(0.01, 0.015, 0.02, 0.025, 0.03, 0.035)
target_list <-list()
all_list <- list()
for(c in cutoffs){
  print(c)
  lung_grn <-
    lapply(ct_order, function(i) {
      f <- fread(sprintf("%s/sparsity%s/L_%s_GRN.txt", data_dir, c, i))
      return(lapply(split(f, f$Regulator), function(i){i$Target}))
    })
  names(lung_grn) <- ct_order
  target_list[[as.character(c)]] <- lung_grn
  all_genes <-
     lapply(ct_order, function(i) {
      f <- fread(sprintf("%s/sparsity%s/L_%s_GRN.txt", data_dir, c, i))
      return(unique(f$Target))
    })
  names(all_genes) <- ct_order
  all_list[[as.character(c)]] <- all_genes
}

nTargets_tbl <- c()
for(i in names(target_list)) {
  for(j in names(target_list[[i]])) {
    nTargets_tbl <- 
      rbind(nTargets_tbl, 
        data.frame(
      cutoff = i,
      CellType = j,
      nTargets = median(unlist(lapply(target_list[[i]][[j]], length)))
    ))
  }
}

nTargets_tbl <- readRDS("../data/plotting_inputs/grn_median_targetsPerTF.RDS")
ggplot(nTargets_tbl %>%
         mutate(CellType = factor(CellType,
                                  levels = ct_order)),
       aes(x = CellType,
           y = nTargets,
           fill = CellType)) + 
  geom_col(width = 0.3) + 
  facet_grid(cutoff ~ .) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_rna) + 
  theme_pub() + ylab("Median target counts per TF") + xlab("") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
  
```

```{r}
EnrichmentTest <- function(var1, var2, bkg){
  # fisher exact test
  mat <- matrix(
    c(length(intersect(var1, var2)),
      length(intersect(setdiff(bkg, var2), var1)),
      length(intersect(setdiff(bkg, var1), var2)),
      length(intersect(setdiff(bkg, var1), setdiff(bkg, var2)))
    ), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  print(mat)
  res <- fisher.test(mat)
  out <- data.frame(
    p_value = format(res$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2),
    odds_ratio = round(res$estimate, 2),
    conf_low = round(res$conf.int[1], 2),
    conf_high = round(res$conf.int[2], 2)
    #method = res$method
  )
  return(out)
}
```

## Validate GRNs with several analyses

```{r}
f_markers <- read.csv("output/lung_GRN_regulatory_markers.csv")
f_TFs <- read.csv("output/lung_GRN_TFs.csv", row.names = 1)
# test whether lung up-regulated genes enriched for regulatory markers in lung immune cells
marker_expr <- fread("output/u19_multiomics/output/DE_analysis_wilcox/CD8_T_DE_results.csv")
DGE_tbl <- do.call(rbind, btw_tissue)
DGE_tbl$cluster <- unlist(lapply(rownames(DGE_tbl), function(i){strsplit(i, "[.]")[[1]][1]}))
DGE_tbl$gene <- unlist(lapply(rownames(DGE_tbl), function(i){strsplit(i, "[.]")[[1]][2]}))
pct_min = 0.01
sub_DGE <-
    DGE_tbl %>% filter(!cluster %in% c("Other", "Th17", "Treg") & p_val_adj <= 0.05) %>%
        filter(pct.1 >= pct_min | pct.2 >= pct_min) %>%
        mutate(group = case_when(avg_log2FC >= 0.58 ~ "Lung Up-regulated", 
                                 avg_log2FC <= -0.58 ~ "Spleen Up-regulated",
                                 abs(avg_log2FC) < 0.58 ~ "Not Significant"))
```

### Known lineage TFs show larger DE and DR values

```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8}
library(ggrepel)

for(i in c(0.015)){
  f <- fread(sprintf("%s/sparsity%s/L_CD4_T_Memory_B_DE_DR_logFC.txt", data_dir, i))
  colnames(f)[1] <- "gene"
  p <- 
    ggplot(
      f, 
      aes(x = DE_logFC,
          y = DR_logFC,
          label = ifelse(DE_logFC >= 1 & DR_logFC >= 1 |
                           (DE_logFC <= -1 & DR_logFC <= -1), gene, ""))) + 
      geom_point(size = 0.5) + 
      geom_text_repel(size = 4) + 
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0) + 
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + 
      theme_pub(base_size = 15) + 
      ggtitle("Memory_B vs. CD4_T")
  print(p)
}

```

```{r}
select_TFs <-
  lapply(cutoffs, function(i) {
    f <- fread(sprintf("%s/sparsity%s/L_CD4_T_Naive_B_DE_DR_logFC.txt", data_dir, i))
    colnames(f)[1] <- "gene"
    markers <-
      f %>% filter(
        DE_logFC <= -1 & DR_logFC <= -1) %>%
      pull(gene)
    return(markers)
  })

```

### Testing enrichment of DE genes among target genes of marker TFs

```{r, fig.height = 8}
set.seed(101)
ct <- "CD4_T"
marker_expr <- readRDS(sprintf("%s/lung_CD4_T_vs_Mem_B_DEG.RDS", data_dir))
DEGenes <- 
  marker_expr %>% 
    mutate(gene = rownames(marker_expr)) %>%
    filter(p_val_adj <= 0.05 & avg_log2FC >= 0.58) %>%
    pull(gene)


enrich_out <-
  lapply(names(target_list), function(i) {
    out_tbl <- c()
    for(j in unique(unlist(select_TFs))) {
      if (j %in% names(target_list[[as.character(i)]][[ct]])) {
        target <- unique(target_list[[as.character(i)]][[ct]][[j]])
        out_tbl = rbind(out_tbl, EnrichmentTest(target, DEGenes, all_genes[[ct]]))
      }
    } 
    return(data.frame(out_tbl, TF = unique(unlist(select_TFs)), cutoff = i))
})

enrich_out <-
  do.call(rbind, enrich_out) %>% 
    na.replace(0) 

count_tbl <- 
  enrich_out %>% 
    group_by(cutoff) %>% 
      dplyr::summarise(numEnriched= sum(p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr") <= 0.05 & odds_ratio > 1),
                numNotEnriched = sum(p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr") >0.05 | odds_ratio <= 1))

count_tbl
```

## Applying lung GRNs to asthma genetics

```{r}
aoa <- read.table("data/aoa_gene_scores.txt", header = T)
coa <- read.table("data/coa_gene_scores.txt", header = T)
gene_scores <- 
  rbind(data.frame(aoa[aoa$Score >= 0.4, ], Trait = "aoa"),
        data.frame(coa[coa$Score >= 0.4,], Trait = "coa"))
```

### Identify target genes for asthma risk genes that are TFs

```{r}
novel_TFs <-strsplit("IL15RA,IL2RA,PRKCQ,CXCR5,DDX6,OVOL1,LRRC32,ERBB3,IKZF4,RPS26,LRP1,IQCH,CCR7,SMARCE1,OSBPL7,TBX21,TNFRSF11A,CEBPA,TNFSF4,CCL20,D2HGDH,CCR4,TMPPE,TRIM71,TLR1,IRF1,BACH2,ARRDC1,DPH7,CACNA1B,WDR36,IL13", ",")[[1]]
asthma_TFs <- 
  unique(unlist(lapply(names(target_list$`0.015`), function(i){
    intersect(c(unique(gene_scores$Gene), novel_TFs), names(target_list$`0.015`[[i]]))}
    )))

asthma_TFs
```

```{r}
asthma_out <- c()
for(i in asthma_TFs) {
  enrich_out <-
    lapply(ct_order[ct_order!= "Other"], function(j) {
      EnrichmentTest(var1 = target_list$`0.015`[[j]][[i]],
                     var2 = gene_scores$Gene,
                     bkg = all_genes[[j]])
  })
  enrich_out <- do.call(rbind, enrich_out)
  enrich_out$CellType <- ct_order[ct_order!= "Other"]
  asthma_out <- rbind(asthma_out, data.frame(TF = i, enrich_out))
}

asthma_out$FDR <- p.adjust(asthma_out$p_value, method = "fdr")
asthma_out %>% filter(FDR <= 0.1)
```

## Identify master regulators for asthma

Master regulators are defined as TFs that target significantly more asthma risk genes than expected by chance.

```{r}

# Other option: testing all marker TFs with 100 or more targets
sparsity = "0.015"
idx <- which(sapply(target_list[[sparsity]][["CD4_T"]], function(i){length(i) >= 100}) == TRUE)
regTFs <- unique(names(target_list[[sparsity]][["CD4_T"]])[idx])

tf_tbl <- c()
for(ct in ct_order) {
  #regTFs <- novel_TFs
  # test enrichment for asthma risk genes across marker TFs
  idx <- which(sapply(target_list$`0.015`[[ct]], function(i){length(i) >= 100}) == TRUE)
  regTFs <- unique(names(target_list$`0.015`[[ct]])[idx])
  gene_set <- gene_scores$Gene
  out_tbl <-
    lapply(regTFs, function(i){
      target = unique(target_list[[sparsity]][[ct]][[i]])
      return(EnrichmentTest(var1 = target, var2 = gene_set, bkg = all_list[[sparsity]][[ct]]))
    })
  out_tbl <- do.call(rbind, out_tbl)
  #rownames(out_tbl) <- sprintf("%s(%s)", regTFs$gene, regTFs$CellType)
  out_tbl <- data.frame(TF = regTFs, out_tbl)
  tf_tbl <- rbind(
    tf_tbl,
    data.frame(
      out_tbl,
      CellType = ct,
      FDR = p.adjust(out_tbl$p_value, method = "fdr"),
      row.names = NULL
    ))
}

```

```{r}
ggplot(tf_tbl %>%

           label = p_value)) + 
  geom_point() + ylab("") + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted") +
```
